body:
Part of #289; coordinate the structure audit and higher-model investigation. Priority: conditional on a named construction benefit, not a prerequisite for all direct models. The initial applicability assessment is actionable without committing to a general strictifier.

## Question

Would local universes or another strictification construction enable a concrete intended model or reduce a demonstrated model-builder burden? If so, construct its hypotheses rather than adding them to every generic model.

## Acceptance

- Name the consumer and expected gain. Compare direct strict construction, local universes and coherent right splitting/chosen-universe alternatives on the same fragment. The current groupoid model is already strict; recovering its established substitution laws alone is not a new benefit.
- Use the structure audit's reconstruction results. Choose the actual family morphisms and prove the full-comprehension correspondence, terminal/finite-product properties and the exact LF dependent-exponential representations needed by the chosen theorem. Verify naturality and universal properties; do not turn these desired results into assumed fields.
- Distinguish a category reconstructed from all display-map squares from a separately intended concrete category. Establish their relation before transferring a fullness claim. Distinguish ambient and generated contexts and verify size/universe assumptions.
- Establish constructor-specific weak or pseudo stability, including eliminators and dependent branch data, then apply only the supported transfer theorem. Audit extra type equations separately. Recover the named native clients and selected data through explicit comparisons.
- If the initial comparison finds no justified benefit, record the precise unproved hypotheses, evidence for direct construction, and a promotion trigger under #289; do not label the setting inapplicable or the categorical package completed. If a concrete benefit exists, carry the hypothesis construction through the relevant example or identify the exact blocking theorem with owned continuation.

## Evidence and boundaries

Use `docs/research/dependent-architecture-reassessment.md`, its three independent assessments, #292's report and frozen external memo as starting evidence. Consult primary sources for the claims actually used. These are competing diagnoses and proposals, not new checked theorems. The work is scoped by its mathematical questions, not an arbitrary effort cap. Substantial reconstruction or a different foundation is an allowed outcome; an immediate adapter to current generated annotations is not a condition for investigating it.

Keep object-language identity, judgmental equality, metatheoretic equality and presentation comparisons distinct. State which observations an interpretation preserves; a deliberately lossy interpretation is not invalid merely because it is not faithful. Require exact selected data when the client contract calls for it. Separate model-builder work, ordinary author work and host-language encoding cost.

Persist findings, failed approaches, positive constructions, exact hypotheses and the adopt/investigate/defer/reject decision. New Lean claims require checked specializations, statement review and README's applicable build/exhaustive audit. Research and implementation require independent Standards/Spec review. This issue does not resume #107, select or prepare #108's fresh theorem, activate #260, require a new frontend, or authorize weakening the mathematical acceptance conditions.

## Coordination

Use #314 reconstruction evidence when relevant and #316 if its selected higher route needs strictification. This conditional construction is not a blanket dependency of #315, #319 or direct models.
title: Assess and construct the categorical hypotheses for a concrete dependent model
